title: legend
Amon Hen's shared icons — what each shap: Rules (16×16 grid, 1.5 strokes, round ends and joins, one color: the text color)

title: head
column3: One skeleton (top line = remote, circle = local commit), four variations

title: icon
column4: An arrow comes down from the remote but doesn't reach a local commit: fetching moves no local branch.

title: icon
column4: The arrow reaches the local commit: fetch and bring it in. The circle is the only difference from Fetch.

title: icon
column4: An arrow rises from the local commit to the remote: Pull upside down.

title: icon
column4: Push with a dotted remote: there is no upstream yet.

title: icon
column4: A branch leaves the trunk for a commit; the circle at the root shows it starts at a commit.

title: icon
column4: Branch with a + instead of the tip's circle: a branch about to be made.

title: icon
column4: Branch turned upside down: a line from the right comes back into the trunk, and the circle on top is the merge commit. It pairs with Branch.

title: icon
column4: A branch and its commit on top of the trunk, with dots where the branch used to start: its base moved up the trunk.

title: head
column3: a drawer = where things are put away

title: icon
column4: An arrow into a drawer with a handle: put the changes away. Unlike a generic download mark.

title: icon
column4: An arrow out of the drawer: take them back out. Pairs with Stash.

title: head
column3: Familiar shapes read fastest, so these stay conventional

title: icon
column4: A window with a divider on the left: show or hide the left column.

title: icon
column4: Books on a shelf: the library of repositories.

title: icon
column4: A pulse trace: what runs in the background, and its log.

title: icon
column4: An almost full circle with an arrow.

title: icon
column4: An arrow back to the left that curls down: undo one step. Not circled, so it doesn't stand out in the toolbar.

title: icon
column4: A sheet with a folded corner: one file.
